verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding agent, and outbound event webhooks are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. `--watch-files` (an inbound file-watching trigger) and the `--message`/Python scripting interface are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not webhook subscriptions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
